title: Maximum AND Sum of Array
goal: Assign numbers to slots of capacity two to maximize the sum of number AND slot.
strategy: Encode each slot occupancy as a base-three digit: zero one or two. The total occupancy tells which input number comes next, and each available slot yields one transition.
